prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Photo-oxidation causes rapid degradation of polyunsaturated oils under UV-A radiation, with peroxide value increasing sixfold faster, and degradation products including lipid endoperoxides and epoxides.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06406","field":"abstract","quote":"Peroxide value increased sixfold faster under UV-A"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Light intensity is the dominant variable controlling shelf life of oily functional foods under retail conditions, exceeding the effect of temperature fluctuations.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04277","field":"abstract","quote":"Sensitivity analysis identified light intensity as the dominant variable controlling shelf life under retail conditions, exceeding the effect of temperature fluctuations"}]}]}
